Prompt 3:

Use the callmebot API to send a whatsapp message to the guardian when the call is flagged as dangerous. The guardian phone number should be configurable in the web UI. The API for callmebot is:

- [https://api.callmebot.com/whatsapp.php?phone=REDACTED&text=\[message\]&apikey=](https://api.callmebot.com/whatsapp.php?phone=REDACTED\&text=\[message]\&apikey=)REDACTED 
- The API key is REDACTED

Example message:

 **🟡 Amber (score 50+)**

> ⚠️ Scam the Scammer Alert\
>  A call to Margaret is showing suspicious patterns.\
>  Score: 52/100\
>  🔸 Caller claims to be Tyler\
>  🔸 Emotional distress detected\
>  🔸 Money requested (CHF 5,000)\
>  Call is live — listen in at app.scamthescammer.ch

>  Call to Margaret is highly suspicious.\

>  This call is very likely a scam.\
